label: Mechanism
description: Prioritize mechanistic hypotheses and alternative explanations. Keep causal language conservative and explicitly hypothesis-tiered.
intent: Use this when the user wants a mechanistic story, but the report should clearly separate evidence from causal speculation.

sections.heading: Question and Context
sections.guidance: Frame the biological question, sample context, and the key signals that motivate a mechanistic interpretation.

sections.heading: Mechanistic Hypotheses
sections.guidance: Lay out the main mechanism candidates in plain language, making clear what each hypothesis is trying to explain.

sections.heading: Supporting Evidence
sections.guidance: Tie each hypothesis to the strongest artifacts, literature findings, pathways, or disease associations currently available.

sections.heading: Alternative Explanations
sections.guidance: Describe plausible competing explanations, including technical, biological, or cohort-level alternatives.

sections.heading: Hypothesis Tiers
sections.guidance: Rank the mechanism ideas by confidence, explicitly distinguishing supported interpretations from weaker hypotheses.

sections.heading: Critical Next Checks
sections.guidance: List the most useful next searches, validations, or experiments that would strengthen or falsify the leading mechanism.
